summary: FRESHTECH HOLDING AS (org. no. 982 711 754) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2000-12-14. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.500 (Engroshandel med informasjons- og kommunikasjonsteknologiutstyr); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 11 792 and net income was NOK 173 969. CEO: Gerdt Holm Johnstad; board chair: Gerdt Holm Johnstad.
